artworks.title: Dr. John Warren
artworks.medium: black, white, and light brown chalk on dark brown paper
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Andrew W. Mellon Fund and Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a person's head and part of the upper chest. The person is facing forward with their head slightly tilted to one side. The facial features are well-defined, with high cheekbones, a straight nose, and medium lips. The person has wavy hair that is receding slightly from the forehead. They are wearing a high-collared shirt with an elaborate cravat. The background is a plain textured surface. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: The Cape of Pinzon
artworks.medium: brown and black chalk heightened with white chalk and pastel on blue board
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Andrew W. Mellon Fund and Avalon Fund
artworks.description: The image is an artistic drawing showing a person from behind. The drawing focuses on the upper body, with minimal details on the head and unfinished lower legs. The person stands with one hand on the hip. Facial features are not depicted, and the hair blends into the unfinished details. The person wears a draped garment over the shoulders with soft folds for texture and movement. The visible hand on the hip shows details of the clothing's texture and creases. In the background, there is a faint sketch of a similar draped garment seemingly for further exploration by the artist. The scene is set against a plain blue-green backdrop.

artworks.title: George III Resuming Royal Power in 1789
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection, Andrew W. Mellon Fund and Avalon Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering or ceremony. The composition includes a group of figures, some standing and some seated around a table-like structure. The figures are drawn in an outline style with minimal detail to their faces or clothing. The setting is suggested by oval shapes and swirling clouds in the background. The design gives the impression of a preliminary study capturing movement and layout.

artworks.title: Pieter Bruegel the Younger
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 24.6 x 15.7 cm (9 11/16 x 6 3/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert M. Walker in memory of Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a seated man from the waist up. He is sitting in a dignified pose with his head slightly turned to the left, eyes looking forward. The man has a beard, mustache, and short wavy hair. He wears a ruffled collar common in the Renaissance era, with buttons on the front of his garment. One hand rests on his lap, while the other is hidden. The background is simple, emphasizing the man.

artworks.title: Head of Saint John the Baptist
artworks.medium: black chalk on two joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a man's head in side profile. The man has a large, flowing beard with intricate curls. His facial features include deep-set eyes and a slightly furrowed brow. His curly hair fills a significant portion of the portrait, blending into the voluminous beard. The drawing emphasizes line and form, with detailed texture on the hair and beard. Inscribed on the right side are the letters "JCB" and the year "1516." The background is plain, focusing on the intricacy of the hair.

artworks.title: A Stormy Landscape
artworks.medium: gouache on kidskin backed with paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Gift of David Tunick
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with figures and animals close to us, a cluster of trees leaning towards the right, and a thatched roof house in the distance. The horizon line is low, showcasing distant hills and trees under a dramatic sky. The brushwork is dynamic, capturing movement, notably in the wind-swept trees. The color palette features earthy tones and cooler hues dominating the sky. A church spire slightly punctures the skyline to the right, amid swirling clouds and wildlife, enhancing the depth and activity within the scene.

artworks.title: Christ as Salvator Mundi
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious manuscript page. The central part of the image contains an illustration of a religious figure, characterized by a halo, wearing ornate robes in red and blue with gold detailing, holding a scepter topped with a cross in one hand and making a gesture with the other. The illustration is set within a framed oval and topped with the Latin phrase. Surrounding the illustration, there is dense, neat calligraphic text written in Latin. Each page corner hosts circular elements detailing the four Evangelists - John, Luke, Mark, and Matthew - with text that seems to elaborate on their contributions.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene with two figures on either side of a central figure on a cross. The central figure is depicted with a crown of thorns and is nailed to a cross with signs of blood from the hands and side. On the left, a figure cloaked in robes stands with hands in prayer and a halo above, while on the right, another figure stands with hands clasped and a similar halo. The style is late medieval woodcut art, characteristic of Northern European religious iconography. The use of bold outlines and color indicates a traditional religious narrative artwork from the period, potentially reflecting Gothic artistic influences with emphasis on expressive line work and symbolic representation. The background shows a simple color gradient.

artworks.title: Saint Agnes
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut with manuscript inscriptions on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing, holding a palm leaf and a basket. The person has a halo around their head and stylized facial features with rounded eyes. They have short, curly hair and wear flowing robes in earthy tones. Beside them stands a small figure with a halo, resembling a lamb. The background contains text around the image.

artworks.title: The Rape of a Sabine
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in light brown-green
artworks.description: The sculpture in the image shows three human figures interacting with each other. The central figure, a woman, is being lifted by a male figure below her, who is standing on a crouched third male figure. The woman reaches upwards with one arm extended high, looking upwards. All three figures are nude, displaying muscular physiques and dynamic poses. The sculpture appears to be made of a material resembling stone or marble, with a smooth texture and uniform light brown color. The composition is captured from a slightly elevated angle, highlighting the intertwined forms of the figures, suggesting motion and tension.

artworks.title: Striding Man
artworks.medium: engraving with stipple on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a muscular, bearded man standing with his head slightly tilted downward and arms crossed over his chest. He has sharply defined facial features, a prominent nose, intense gaze, and a long beard. He is wearing a helmet with a pointed top and draped in a cloth that partially covers his body, leaving his broad chest, arms, and muscular legs exposed. The background is blank.

artworks.title: The Nativity with God the Father and the Holy Spirit
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching featuring several figures in a dynamic composition. At the center, a woman is seated, holding an infant and looking affectionately at them. Surrounding them are other figures, including a man with long hair and a beard, and other individuals with subtle smiles. The etching is intricate, with lines creating texture and movement. The background includes architectural elements and foliage, adding depth to the scene. Light appears to emanate from above the infant, highlighting them as a focal point.

artworks.title: Christ before Caiaphas
artworks.artist: Master of the Dutuit Mount of Olives after Master of St. Erasmus
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people in medieval artwork style. On the left, a person is seated on a throne-like chair, wearing an elaborate blue robe with gold trims and a tall, pink hat with a crown-like band. They have a contemplative expression. In the center, a person with a halo stands, dressed in a long red robe, with long brown hair and a beard, being held by another figure. The accompanying figure is dressed in beige clothing with pink and red accents, including a hood and patterned red leggings, raising an arm in a gesture. On the right side, another person is partly visible, wearing a blue garment with a hood. The background features a patterned surface with red, yellow, and blue elements, creating an ornate and vibrant composition.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: In the image, a person is depicted from the knees up in a seated position, slightly leaning back with their head tilted upwards. The individual's facial features are outlined with soft lines, showing a serene expression, and their long hair flows down their back. They are dressed in draped clothing with fluid lines indicating fabric folds. The person reaches out with one arm towards a bird flying above them, set against a background with diagonal lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The etching depicts a central reclining figure with a group of standing and seated individuals surrounding them. The figures have intricate facial features, flowing hair, and are dressed in loose garments. The background features dense, cross-hatched lines while the foreground shows detailed foliage with large leaves.

artworks.title: Judith
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures amidst drapery and clouds. The central figure is holding an object resembling a large knife or scythe. The figure is robed, with fabric flowing around the body and has a prominent stance. To the right, there is another figure, also enveloped in drapery, near the central character. The background includes clouds and a textured surface underfoot, all rendered with fine line work and shaded hatching.

artworks.title: Saint Thaïs
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a seated person. The person is depicted from head to toe, seated with their body slightly hunched forward and arms crossed over their lap. The facial features are minimally detailed, with the face angled downward and hair styled away from the face. The person is wrapped in a large piece of draped clothing, like a robe or shawl. To the left of the person in the background, there is a large urn or vase. The background consists of vertical and horizontal lines that suggest a wall and a patterned surface.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a seated woman holding a child. The woman's body is turned slightly sideways, and her gaze is directed towards the child in her arms. Her facial features are softly drawn and she has wavy hair styled loosely around her head. The woman is dressed in a long, flowing garment with draped sleeves. The child she holds is nestled close with its head facing the woman. Both the woman and the child have finely detailed hair and features. The woman wears a circular halo above her head. The background is filled with intricate cross-hatching. The setting includes architectural elements like a pillar or column close to where the subjects are positioned.

artworks.title: The Rape of Proserpina
artworks.medium: woodcut and wood engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures on a chariot being pulled by horses. Both figures are in motion, with one holding a trident and the other raising an arm as if commanding the horses. The horses appear tense and their manes are flying back as they run. The sky above has dramatic, curvilinear clouds. The foreground depicts a rocky terrain. The image is in black, white, and gray colors, with strong lines used for texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Apostle Jean Journet Setting Out for the Conquest of Universal Harmony
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing outdoors with a rugged appearance. He has a thick beard, unkempt hair, and an intense gaze. He is wearing a tattered coat, tunic, and pants, carrying a bag and a walking stick. The background depicts a rural landscape with silhouetted trees and a hazy horizon. Surrounding text is in French.

artworks.title: View of Pont de la Tournelle and Notre Dame Taken from the Arsnel: pl.11
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching retouched with brown and ochre washes
artworks.description: The image is a cityscape viewed from a riverbank. The horizon is high, showing the city's architecture. Features include twin cathedral towers, likely Notre Dame, standing out amidst buildings. The drawing style has fine brushstrokes highlighting architectural details. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving an antique feel. A small boat is by the riverbank, and stacked materials are visible. Building reflections in the water cause ripples.

artworks.title: View of the Village of Chaillot from the  Pont de la Concorde: pl.17
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching retouched with pencil and brown and ochre washes
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside walkway with a cityscape across the water. The buildings form a jagged line against the sky. There are small boats at the water's edge, and a figure is sitting on the bank. Some people are walking along the walkway, and others are scattered along the riverbank path. The style features fine brushstrokes and a sepia tone, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image shows a complex scene with several figures. A woman sits elevated, holding a child, between two tall columns. Above them are three ethereal figures. The woman and child have halos behind their heads. A bearded man stands beside them. Other figures are around them, engaging in various activities. Some have long, wavy hair and wear layered clothing. In the background, there are animals, more people approaching, rocky terrain, and a structure. Hills or mountains are faintly visible in the distance under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Pont-y-Pair over the River Conway above Llanrwst in the County of Denbigh
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and lift-ground aquatint with burnishing printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a stone bridge over a river with waterfalls. The perspective is from below the bridge, showcasing the water cascading over rocks. In the background, there are mountains and trees on both sides of the river. The painting features detailed brushstrokes capturing the textures of rocks and water. The color scheme is mainly sepia.
